fields.summary: Add bulk export to CSV feature for reports
fields.description:
Users need the ability to export report data in bulk to CSV. Currently, they can only export one record at a time, which is very slow for large datasets. This feature would allow selecting multiple records and downloading them in a single CSV file.

Requested by 5+ enterprise customers.

comments.body: Confirmed request from 5 enterprise accounts. This is blocking their monthly reporting workflow.
